carousels.caption: Global markets hit correction territory this week as tech, crypto, and commodities suffered steep declines. Key technical levels are now being tested across major asset classes. Follow for tomorrow's update.

slides.title: S&P 500 enters correction at 6,910
slides.body: Here is how tech, crypto, and commodities plunged across major global markets this week.

slides.title: Wall Street in correction
slides.body: The S&P 500 tumbled 8.6% to close at 6,910. Meanwhile, the Nasdaq dropped 10.0% to 22,618. Sustaining levels above 6,900 points remains crucial.

slides.title: Tech leads $2.3 trillion wipeout
slides.body: Semiconductor leaders wiped out $2.3 trillion in value. Nvidia holding above $150 keeps potential support, but falling below $127 risks a drop to $100.

slides.title: Bitcoin breaks critical support levels
slides.body: Bitcoin dropped 11.7% to $57,680. Ethereum fell 11.3% to $1,628. Holding above $57,000 allows a potential recovery toward $63,000.

slides.title: Gold and oil sharp unwind
slides.body: Gold fell 9.5% to $3,515 per ounce. Crude Oil dropped 5.2% to $84 per barrel. Holding $3,500 keeps gold in consolidation.

slides.title: Key levels to watch next
slides.body: Key support levels across equities and crypto will determine if markets stabilize next week. Follow for tomorrow's update.
